units.source_text: 太吉郎索性买了两三条不像是龙村出品的龙村领带，还有“揉菊”钱包。

en.t: Taikichiro went ahead and bought two or three Tatsumura ties that did not look as if they had been made by Tatsumura, as well as a Momigiku wallet.

units.source_text: “揉菊”就是在织物上仿制光悦 [3] 在鹰峰做的所谓“大揉菊”纸制手工艺产品，手法比较新颖。

en.t: Momigiku was a textile imitation of the so-called large Momigiku paper handicrafts that Koetsu [3] had made at Takagamine, and the technique was rather novel.
